title: Layering, Ports & Adapters
objectives: Keep business logic independent of HTTP and database details

examples.name: ports.rs

exercise.prompt: Assign each responsibility to its layer: "parse JSON body", "apply refund policy", "SQL INSERT", "orchestrate use-case + ports". Render the mapping.
hints: The refund policy is a domain rule; orchestration is application; SQL is infrastructure.

questions.prompt: A port (trait) should be defined by…
options: the application layer that consumes it
questions.explanation: Application-owned ports let infrastructure swap without touching use-cases.

questions.prompt: The main value of keeping the domain pure (no I/O types) is…
questions.explanation: Pure domain logic is unit-testable and survives transport/storage changes.
